lines.text: Many learners say: How do you think about it?
Better: What do you think about it?
Ask for an idea with what, not how.
What! What do you think about it?

data.wrong: How do you think about it?
data.right: What do you think about it?
data.why: Ask for an idea with what, not how.
data.memory: What do you think about it?

quiz.stem: ___ do you think about this song?

native.tip: 「どう思う？」の「どう」を how にしがちですが、意見を聞くときは what。
native.caption: “How do you think about it?”と言っていませんか？😅 「どう」を how と訳して How do you think と言いがちです。“What do you think about it?” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“What”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Use what to ask for an idea.
en.caption: Do you say this? “How do you think about it?” 😅 Use what, not how, to ask for an idea. The natural way is “What do you think about it?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
